title: IKEA Family: Eat on 24th, 25th, 31, 1st Oct $25 Worth of Food from Restaurant, Receive $15 off Voucher with $0 Spend @ IKEA
body:
Deal: IKEA Family: Eat on 24th, 25th, 31, 1st Oct $25 Worth of Food from Restaurant, Receive $15 off Voucher with $0 Spend @ IKEA

[Averell] 2-3 years ago they gave $30 for $30 spent, but the voucher is only valid on the same day.
[Wiadro] I used this today. Was going to post as deal but didn’t think it was special enough
[Shaolinking] Food there is overprice, not value anymore like it used to.
[lplau] Been ages since they have ran their 'eat your discount'.
Wished they bought that back.
[EitherWayUp] Eat $25 worth of food to get a $15 voucher.. why does this sounds dystopian? Just picturing a bunch of grown adults desperately chowing down like animals to get their reward.
[R4] Calling it a restaurant is a stretch but hey ho.
I'd go with canteen.
[whyisave] Terms and conditions
Promotion: During a Saturday or Sunday within the Promotional Period, all IKEA
AU Family Members will receive a discount voucher of $15 value (off IKEA home
furnishing products) when they spend $25 or more on any Qualifying Food
Purchases (at the Swedish Restaurant at any Participating Store during the
Promotional Period).
<Truncated>
IKEA Family Members: This Promotion is only available to IKEA AU Family
members who present their membership at the IKEA Swedish Restaurant registers
by the exit.
Promotion Period: The Promotion Period is on four selective dates only (each date
falling on a Saturday or Sunday):
• Saturday 24 October 2026
• Sunday 25 October 2026
• Saturday 31 October 2026
• Sunday 1 November 2026
Qualifying Food Purchases: Any food items at the Swedish Restaurant from the
following:
a. Any Mains or Wraps or Salads;
b. Any meals from the IKEA ‘Kids menu’ or
c. Any item from the IKEA ‘Something Sweet’ menu
but does not include any drink beverages and/or any pre-packaged food products
sold at the Swedish Restaurant (including biscuits and chocolate products)
< Truncated >
Voucher redemption conditions: The $15 voucher is only redeemable towards
IKEA home furnishing products and will be provided upon confirmation of the
minimum spend threshold of $25 (on Qualifying Food Purchases) has been reached
and payment within a single transaction at the Swedish Restaurant registers.
The $15 voucher:
a. is a single use voucher and will be exhausted upon redemption;
b. must be redeemed in-store on the same day (and cannot be used online) ;
c. cannot be combined with any other issued voucher(s) on redemption - only
one single $15 voucher will be validated in any transaction; and
d. cannot be redeemed towards the following:
• any products that are not considered a home furnishing product (e.g.
including IKEA kitchens and/or appliances);
• any products that are not available in stock for purchase on the voucher
issue date;
• any products from our ‘As-is market’ (either in-store or online);
• IKEA services (assembly, delivery or installation of IKEA home furnishing
products)
[Its4me] How many hot dogs must one eat to qualify?
